Malaysia takaful industry penetration structural growth 2026 2027 outlook

findings.claim: CIMB 預期公司 FY26–FY28 進入較常態、可持續的成長期，難以複製 FY24、FY25 的家庭takaful總繳費高成長；評等降為 Hold
findings.source: New Straits Times, Takaful Malaysia set for normalised growth, CIMB cuts to 'Hold'
findings.excerpt: The firm also is unlikely to replicate the robust family takaful gross contribution growth achieved in financial years 2024 and 2025.

findings.claim: RAM Ratings 預期 2026 年壽險與家庭takaful新業務大致持平（2025 年輕微萎縮），產業展望維持穩定
findings.source: The Star, RAM Ratings maintains stable outlook on Malaysia's insurance, takaful sector
findings.excerpt: RAM expects new business growth for life insurance and family takaful to remain broadly flat in 2026, following a slight contraction in 2025

findings.claim: 馬來西亞 takaful 業近十年 CAGR 逾 10%，約為傳統保險兩倍；takaful 新業務占比由約 20% 升至 2024 年 40%（馬來西亞 Takaful 協會主席說法）
findings.source: theSun Malaysia, Malaysian takaful industry's CAGR tops 10% over past decade, more than double that of conventional sector
findings.excerpt: Takaful's share of new business reportedly rose to 40% in 2024 from just above 20%

findings.claim: 公司稱家庭takaful月總繳費穩定在逾 RM200 百萬，並預期 2027 年初推出政府基本醫療計劃 MediAsas；對產業展望正面
findings.source: The Star, Takaful Malaysia sees positive outlook for takaful, insurance industry

supply_demand_durability.note: As_of for CIMB 與 theSun 為依 URL 月份/年份的近似值；未找到明確 2027–2028 共識需求預測。僅執行 2 次搜尋；Insurance-Specialty 過剩/緊缺與新產能題對本標的不適用，未搜到。
